summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-5 filed an 8-K disclosing a failed remarketing of its class A-6B and A-6C notes. Per the indenture and remarketing agreement, sufficient committed purchasers were not obtained by the April 22, 2026 deadline. Consequently, existing noteholders must retain their notes; the interest rate resets to SOFR plus 0.75% per annum for a three-month term, with the next reset date on July 27, 2026. This is a routine operational event for a structured finance vehicle, not a corporate special situation. No change in ownership or fundamental corporate structure occurs. The filing is an ordinary current report of contractual mechanics under the trust's governing documents.
